glosses: An early manuscript book.
A book bound in the modern manner, by joining pages, as opposed to a rolled scroll.

examples.text: From its inception, the index has provided a window onto the history of the book, for it took the advent of a particular type of book — the codex, a sheaf of pages fastened along one edge — to make an index a practical possibility.

examples.text: Le codex est constitué de 70 feuilles, soit 140 pages ornées de 185 illustrations en couleur, comportant par ailleurs des concepts rédigés au moyen de glyphes.
